project: AI Chef — Indian Recipe Discovery & Cooking Platform

tasks.name: Audit existing project & create full safety backup
tasks.description: Inspect all HTML, CSS, JS datasets (512 recipes) and create complete backup in backup/ and data/original/

tasks.name: Data normalization and export to validated JSON datasets
tasks.description: Extract all 512 recipes from JS datasets into normalized JSON with categories, ingredients, and instructions

tasks.name: Django project structure, apps, configuration and dependencies
tasks.description: Initialize Django config, apps (accounts, recipes, ingredients, pantry, recommendations, favorites, shopping), requirements.txt, .env.example

tasks.name: Database architecture, normalized models & migrations
tasks.description: Define Category, Cuisine, Region, Ingredient, Recipe, RecipeIngredient, RecipeInstruction, UserPantry, FavoriteRecipe, ShoppingList, Substitution models

tasks.name: Data migration & database seeding management command
tasks.description: Implement seed_recipes management command, populate database with 512 recipes, and verify record reconciliation

tasks.name: Python Ingredient Matching & Recommendation Engine
tasks.description: Build high-precision matching engine with controlled synonyms, negative lookahead exclusions, explainable match breakdown, and deterministic ranking

tasks.name: Django REST Framework API development
tasks.description: Build DRF serializers, viewsets, routers, and pagination for auth, recipes, ingredients, pantry, recommendations, favorites, shopping list

tasks.name: Frontend template integration & API bridge
tasks.description: Integrate existing responsive UI into Django templates and static files, connecting to backend DRF endpoints and CSRF tokens

tasks.name: User authentication, profile & personal pantry/favorites
tasks.description: Implement Django auth views and API for registration, login, logout, profile, user-isolated pantry, and saved recipes

tasks.name: Serving calculator, substitution system & shopping list
tasks.description: Implement dynamic serving scaling service, ingredient substitution recommendations, and multi-recipe shopping list generator

tasks.name: Comprehensive automated test suite
tasks.description: Write and run Django unit/integration tests for models, seeding, matching, recommendations, APIs, auth, and user isolation

tasks.name: Security hardening & performance optimization
tasks.description: Verify CSRF, SQL injection protection, XSS sanitization, query optimization (select_related, prefetch_related), and database indexing

tasks.name: Technical documentation, architecture & schema diagrams
tasks.description: Generate comprehensive README, API reference, architecture diagram, database schema diagram, deployment instructions

tasks.name: Final review, git commit and GitHub push
tasks.description: Commit full stack transformation with clean commit message and push to GitHub repository main branch
